how_it_works: Stores one handler per message type
Dispatches by t without reading payloads
Runs disconnect listeners in registration order
purpose: MessageRouter is the single websocket message-handler seam for the code-agent protocol. It routes only by message type, returns fixed internal errors for missing or failing handlers, preserves connection cancellation semantics, and supports idempotent registration.
summary: Dispatches validated device messages to async handlers and runs disconnect listeners safely.

Registers or deliberately replaces an async handler for one message type.
Adds an async disconnect listener once, preserving registration order.
Dispatches a message by t and contains ordinary handler failures with fixed errors.
Calls all registered disconnect listeners and continues after ordinary listener failures.
Installs the process-wide router as the device socket message handler.
